209     def _validate_configs(self) -> None:
210         """Validate the config combinations that a single config class cannot
211         check by itself.
212 
213         Raises:
214             `ValueError`:
215                 If the reserved/buffer ratios don't leave room ahead of the
216                 context compression threshold.
217         """
218         if (
219             self.context_config.reserve_ratio
220             >= self.context_config.trigger_ratio
221         ):
222             raise ValueError(
223                 "The 'reserve_ratio' of the context config must be smaller "
224                 "than its 'trigger_ratio', got "
225                 f"{self.context_config.reserve_ratio} and "
226                 f"{self.context_config.trigger_ratio}.",
227             )
228 
229         if (
230             self.injection_config.inject_runtime_state
231             and self.injection_config.context_buffer_ratio
232             >= self.context_config.trigger_ratio
233         ):
234             raise ValueError(
235                 "The 'context_buffer_ratio' of the injection config must be "
236                 "smaller than the 'trigger_ratio' of the context config, so "
237                 "that the context length is injected before the compression, "
238                 f"got {self.injection_config.context_buffer_ratio} and "
239                 f"{self.context_config.trigger_ratio}.",

246     async def reply_stream(
247         self,
248         inputs: Msg
249         | list[Msg]

251         | UserInterruptEvent
252         | ExternalExecutionResultEvent
253         | None = None,
254         structured_schema: Type[BaseModel] | None = None,
255         yield_final_msg: bool = False,
256     ) -> AsyncGenerator[AgentEvent | Msg, None]:
257         """Reply to the given inputs and stream agent events.
258 
259         Args:
260             inputs (`Msg | list[Msg] | UserConfirmResultEvent | \
261             UserInterruptEvent | ExternalExecutionResultEvent | None`, \
262             optional):
263                 The inputs that trigger this reply. See :meth:`reply` for
264                 the full list of accepted variants.
265             structured_schema (`Type[BaseModel] | None`, optional):
266                 The Pydantic model class that the reply's structured output
267                 must conform to. See :meth:`reply` for details.
268             yield_final_msg (`bool`, defaults to `False`):
269                 If yield the final reply message. When requiring structured
270                 output, use this option to get the final message, and access
271                 it via the `structured_output` attribute.
272 
273         Yields:
274             `AgentEvent | Msg`:
275                 Streamed events produced during the reply.
276 
277         .. note:: If requiring outside interaction for multiple tool calls
278             and only receive partial confirmation or execution results, the
279             agent won't re-send the requiring events for the unconfirmed
280             or unexecuted tool calls.
281         """
282         async for chunk in self._reply(
283             inputs=inputs,
284             structured_schema=structured_schema,
285         ):
286             if isinstance(chunk, Msg) and not yield_final_msg:
287                 continue
288             yield chunk

290     async def reply(
291         self,
292         inputs: Msg
293         | list[Msg]
294         | UserConfirmResultEvent
295         | UserInterruptEvent
296         | ExternalExecutionResultEvent
297         | None = None,
298         structured_schema: Type[BaseModel] | None = None,
299     ) -> Msg:
300         """Reply to the given inputs, consuming all streamed events.
301 
302         Args:
303             inputs (`Msg | list[Msg] | UserConfirmResultEvent | \
304             UserInterruptEvent | ExternalExecutionResultEvent | None`, \
305             optional):
306                 The inputs that trigger this reply. It can be:
307 
308                 - a single `Msg` or a list of `Msg` objects to start a new
309                   reply,
310                 - a `UserConfirmResultEvent` or
311                   `ExternalExecutionResultEvent` to continue from the
312                   outside interaction required by the previous reply,
313                 - a `UserInterruptEvent` to abort a parked reply — the
314                   agent closes all pending tool calls with an interrupted
315                   tool result and ends the reply without entering the
316                   reasoning-acting loop,
317                 - `None` if there is nothing new to feed in (e.g. just
318                   continue from the current state).
319             structured_schema (`Type[BaseModel] | None`, optional):
320                 The Pydantic model class that the reply's structured output
321                 must conform to, with the validated result carried on the
322                 final message's ``structured_output`` attribute as a dict.
323 
324         Returns:
325             `Msg`:
326                 A final reply message.
327         """
328         final_msg: Msg | None = None
329         async for evt_or_msg in self._reply(
330             inputs=inputs,
331             structured_schema=structured_schema,
332         ):
333             if isinstance(evt_or_msg, Msg):
334                 final_msg = evt_or_msg
335         if final_msg is None:
336             raise RuntimeError("Agent did not produce a final message.")
337         return final_msg

400     async def _compress_context_impl(
401         self,
402         context_config: ContextConfig | None = None,
403         instructions: HintBlock | None = None,
404     ) -> None:
405         """Compress the agent's context if the token count exceeds the
406         threshold.
407 
408         Args:
409             context_config (`ContextConfig | None`, optional):
410                 If provided, compress the context with the given context
411                 config. Otherwise, use the default context config in the
412                 agent.
413             instructions (`HintBlock | None`, optional):
414                 Optional hints or instructions injected into the compression
415                 context to guide the summarization behavior.
416         """
417         cfg: ContextConfig = context_config or self.context_config
418 
419         # Count the current tokens
420         kwargs = await self._prepare_model_input()
421         estimated_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(**kwargs)
422 
423         # Skip if no compression is needed
424         threshold = cfg.trigger_ratio * self.model.context_size
425         if estimated_tokens < threshold:
426             return
427 
428         logger.info(
429             "[AGENT %s]: Current token count %d exceeds the threshold %d, "
430             "activating compression.",
431             self.name,
432             int(estimated_tokens),
433             int(threshold),
434         )
435 
436         if len(self.state.context) == 0:
437             # The system prompt and the summary (if exists) exceeds the
438             # threshold, which cannot be compressed, raise the error to the
439             # developer!
440             suffix = ""
441             if self.state.summary:
442                 suffix = "and the compression summary "
443             raise RuntimeError(
444                 f"The system prompt {suffix}exceed(s) the compression "
445                 f"threshold ({threshold} tokens), cannot be compressed.",
446             )
447 
448         # Split the context into the ones to be compressed, and the others to
449         # be reserved
450         tools = kwargs.get("tools", [])
451         (
452             msgs_to_compress,
453             msgs_to_reserve,
454         ) = await self._split_context_for_compression(
455             cfg.reserve_ratio * self.model.context_size,
456             tools,
457         )
458 
459         if len(msgs_to_compress) == 0:
460             # The reserve ratio is too large so that although it exceeds the
461             # trigger threshold, the context to be compressed is empty
462             # Fallback by lowering the reserve ratio to compress more context.
463             logger.warning(
464                 "The reserve ratio %.2f is too large to compress any context."
465                 "Lower the reserve ratio to 0 as a fallback.",
466                 cfg.reserve_ratio,
467             )
468             (
469                 msgs_to_compress,
470                 msgs_to_reserve,
471             ) = await self._split_context_for_compression(
472                 0 * self.model.context_size,
473                 tools,
474             )
475 
476             # The msgs to be compressed cannot be empty here, unless the
477             # system prompt and summary (if any) already exceed the context
478             # length, which we have handled before.
479 
480         # Prepare the messages to compress
481         msgs_system = [
482             SystemMsg(
483                 name="system",
484                 content=await self._get_system_prompt(),
485             ),
486         ]
487         if self.state.summary:
488             msgs_system.append(UserMsg("user", self.state.summary))
489 
490         instruction_msgs: list[Msg] = []
491         if instructions is not None:
492             instruction_msgs.append(
493                 AssistantMsg(
494                     name=self.name,
495                     content=[instructions],
496                 ),
497             )
498 
499         messages = (
500             msgs_system
501             + msgs_to_compress
502             + instruction_msgs
503             + [
504                 UserMsg(name="user", content=cfg.compression_prompt),
505             ]
506         )
507 
508         # The compression prompt may exceed the context length, here we mark
509         # the overflow by a bool flag
510         compression_tool_schema = [
511             {
512                 "type": "function",
513                 "function": {
514                     "name": "generate_structured_output",
515                     "description": "Call this function to generate "
516                     "structured output required by "
517                     "the user.",
518                     "parameters": cfg.summary_schema,
519                 },
520             },
521         ]
522         context_overflow = False
523         estimated_compression_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(
524             messages,
525             compression_tool_schema,
526         )
527         if estimated_compression_tokens > self.model.context_size:
528             logger.warning(
529                 "The current context length exceeds the model's context "
530                 "length (%d tokens), the compression maybe failed due to "
531                 "insufficient reserved context for compression.",
532                 self.model.context_size,
533             )
534             context_overflow = True
535 
536         # Compress the messages
537         try:
538             res = await self.model.generate_structured_output(
539                 messages=messages,
540                 structured_model=cfg.summary_schema,
541             )
542 
543         except Exception as e:
544             if context_overflow:
545                 logger.warning(
546                     "Failed to compress context, which may be caused by "
547                     "insufficient reserved context for compression. "
548                     "Trying to compress by removing the oldest context.",
549                 )
550                 for i in range(1, len(msgs_to_compress) + 1):
551                     messages = (
552                         msgs_system
553                         + msgs_to_compress[i:]
554                         + instruction_msgs
555                         + [
556                             UserMsg(
557                                 name="user",
558                                 content=cfg.compression_prompt,
559                             ),
560                         ]
561                     )
562                     estimated_compression_tokens = (
563                         await self.model.count_tokens(
564                             messages,
565                             compression_tool_schema,
566                         )
567                     )
568                     # Considering trigger_ratio <= 0.9, at least reserve 10%
569                     # tokens for compression response
570                     if (
571                         estimated_compression_tokens
572                         < self.model.context_size * cfg.trigger_ratio
573                     ):
574                         break
575 
576                 res = await self.model.generate_structured_output(
577                     messages=messages,
578                     structured_model=cfg.summary_schema,
579                 )
580 
581             else:
582                 raise e from None
583 
584         if res.finished_reason == FinishedReason.INTERRUPTED:
585             logger.warning(
586                 "The context compression was interrupted and skipped. ",
587             )
588             raise asyncio.CancelledError()
589 
590         # Update the summary
591         async def _apply_change() -> None:
592             """Apply the context change with interruption protection."""
593             new_summary = cfg.summary_template.format(**res.content)
594             if self.offloader:
595                 path = await self.offloader.offload_context(
596                     self.state.session_id,
597                     msgs=msgs_to_compress,
598                 )
599                 new_summary += (
600                     f"\n<system-reminder>The compressed context is offloaded "
601                     f"to '{path}', you can refer to it when needed."
602                     f"</system-reminder>"
603                 )
604 
605             # Protected from interruption
606             await self._clear_unreserved_read_cache(msgs_to_reserve)
607 
608             # Update the context
609             self.state.summary = new_summary
610             self.state.context = msgs_to_reserve
611 
612             logger.info(
613                 "[AGENT %s]: The context compression finished.",
614                 self.name,
615             )
616 
617         apply_task = asyncio.create_task(_apply_change())
618         try:
619             await asyncio.shield(apply_task)
620         except asyncio.CancelledError:
621             await apply_task
622             raise

689     async def _close_unfinished_tool_calls(
690         self,
691     ) -> AsyncGenerator[
692         ToolResultStartEvent | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent | ToolResultEndEvent,
693         None,
694     ]:
695         """Close the unfinished tool calls on interruption, so the next
696         input will be handled normally."""
697         if not self.state.context:
698             return
699 
700         last_msg = self.state.context[-1]
701         if last_msg.role != "assistant" or last_msg.name != self.name:
702             return
703 
704         # Searching for tool calls that requires user confirmation or external
705         # execution without tool results
706         awaiting_tool_calls: dict = {}
707         for index, block in enumerate(last_msg.content):
708             if isinstance(block, ToolCallBlock):
709                 awaiting_tool_calls[block.id] = index
710             elif isinstance(block, ToolResultBlock):
711                 awaiting_tool_calls.pop(block.id, None)
712 
713         interruption_message = (
714             "<system-reminder>The tool call has been interrupted by "
715             "the user.</system-reminder>"
716         )
717 
718         for index in awaiting_tool_calls.values():
719             call_block = last_msg.content[index]
720             assert isinstance(call_block, ToolCallBlock)
721 
722             # An ALLOWED call was already running, so its START was already
723             # emitted — skip it here (checked before flipping to FINISHED).
724             if call_block.state != ToolCallState.ALLOWED:
725                 yield ToolResultStartEvent(
726                     reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
727                     tool_call_id=last_msg.content[index].id,
728                     tool_call_name=last_msg.content[index].name,
729                 )
730 
731             call_block.state = ToolCallState.FINISHED
732             yield ToolResultTextDeltaEvent(
733                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
734                 tool_call_id=last_msg.content[index].id,
735                 delta=interruption_message,
736             )
737             yield ToolResultEndEvent(
738                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
739                 tool_call_id=last_msg.content[index].id,
740                 state=ToolResultState.INTERRUPTED,
741             )
742             last_msg.content.append(
743                 ToolResultBlock(
744                     id=last_msg.content[index].id,
745                     name=last_msg.content[index].name,
746                     output=interruption_message,
747                     state=ToolResultState.INTERRUPTED,
748                 ),
749             )

752         self,

767             event: (
768                 UserConfirmResultEvent
769                 | UserInterruptEvent

775                 inputs,
776                 (
777                     UserConfirmResultEvent,
778                     UserInterruptEvent,
779                     ExternalExecutionResultEvent,

783                 msgs = None
784             else:
785                 event = None
786                 msgs = inputs
787 
788             if event and structured_schema:
789                 logger.warning(
790                     "The given structured_schema is ignored when "
791                     "resuming with a HITL event; the parked reply's "
792                     "schema is used instead.",
793                 )
794 
795             # Parked-interrupt short-circuit: only signal an INTERRUPTED
796             # end when there is actual HITL work to close; otherwise the
797             # session is effectively idle and the call is a silent no-op.
798             # ``finally`` reuses the CancelledError cleanup path when
799             # ``end_event`` is set — no reasoning-acting loop either way.
800             if isinstance(inputs, UserInterruptEvent):
801                 if self.state.has_awaiting_tool_calls(self.name):
802                     end_event = ReplyEndEvent(
803                         session_id=self.state.session_id,
804                         reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
805                         finished_reason=ReplyFinishedReason.INTERRUPTED,
806                     )
807                 return
808 
809             # ===================================================================
810             # Step 1: Checking agent input:
811             #  - if incoming event and agent is waiting for an event
812             #  - if event is None and agent is not waiting for an event
813             # ===================================================================
814             is_awaiting = await self._check_incoming_event(event)
815 
816             # ===================================================================
817             # Step 2: Handling agent event if applicable
818             #  - yield tool result events for the denied tool calls, or
819             #  - update the reply state as a new reply process
820             # ===================================================================
821             if is_awaiting:
822                 async for evt in self._handle_incoming_event(event):
823                     yield evt
824             else:
825                 await self._handle_incoming_messages(msgs)
826                 # Update the context with the incoming message and state
827                 self.state.reply_context = ReplyContext(
828                     reply_id=_generate_id(),
829                     cur_iter=0,
830                     structured_schema=structured_schema,
831                     structured_output=None,
832                 )
833 
834                 yield ReplyStartEvent(
835                     session_id=self.state.session_id,
836                     reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
837                     name=self.name,
838                 )
839 
840             # Update the structured output tool for new requirements or
841             #  from the previous reply
842             await self.toolkit.remove_tool(_GenerateStructuredOutput.name)
843             if self.state.reply_context.structured_schema:
844                 await self.toolkit.add_tool(
845                     _GenerateStructuredOutput(
846                         schema=self.state.reply_context.structured_schema,
847                     ),
848                 )
849 
850             # =================================================================
851             # Step 3: Enter the reasoning-acting loop until reaching max_iters
852             #  or no more tool calls to execute
853             # =================================================================
854             final_msg: Msg | None = None
855             while True:
856                 # =============================================================
857                 # Step 3.1: Decide the next action based on the current state
858                 # =============================================================
859                 next_action = self._next_action(final_msg)
860 
861                 match next_action:
862                     case Exit(exit_msg=exit_msg, exit_events=exit_events):
863                         for exit_event in exit_events or []:
864                             yield exit_event
865                         if exit_msg:
866                             yield exit_msg
867                         return
868 
869                     case Reasoning(hint=hint, tool_choice=tool_choice):
870                         final_msg = None
871                         if hint:
872                             self.state.append_context(self.name, [hint])
873 
874                         # Compressed the memory if needed before reasoning
875                         await self.compress_context()
876 
877                         # Inject runtime state if needed before reasoning
878                         async for evt in self._inject_runtime_state():
879                             yield evt
880 
881                         # Perform reasoning
882                         interrupted = False
883                         async for evt in self._reasoning(
884                             tool_choice=tool_choice,
885                         ):
886                             if isinstance(evt, Msg):
887                                 # Candidate final message; ``_next_action``
888                                 # decides whether it ends the reply
889                                 final_msg = evt
890                                 continue
891 
892                             if isinstance(evt, ModelCallEndEvent):
893                                 interrupted = (
894                                     evt.finished_reason
895                                     == FinishedReason.INTERRUPTED
896                                 )
897 
898                             yield evt
899 
900                         if interrupted:
901                             end_event = ReplyEndEvent(
902                                 session_id=self.state.session_id,
903                                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
904                                 finished_reason=(
905                                     ReplyFinishedReason.INTERRUPTED
906                                 ),
907                             )
908                             return
909 
910                     case Acting(tool_calls=tool_calls):
911                         for batch in await self._batch_tool_calls(tool_calls):
912                             if batch.type == "sequential":
913                                 evt_generator = (
914                                     self._execute_sequential_tool_calls(
915                                         batch.tool_calls,
916                                     )
917                                 )
918 
919                             elif batch.type == "concurrent":
920                                 evt_generator = (
921                                     self._execute_concurrent_tool_calls(
922                                         batch.tool_calls,
923                                     )
924                                 )
925 
926                             else:
927                                 raise ValueError(
928                                     f"Invalid batch type: {batch.type}",
929                                 )
930 
931                             break_execution_for_hitl = False
932                             break_execution_for_interruption = False
933                             async for evt in evt_generator:
934                                 yield evt
935                                 if isinstance(
936                                     evt,
937                                     (
938                                         RequireUserConfirmEvent,
939                                         RequireExternalExecutionEvent,
940                                     ),
941                                 ):
942                                     break_execution_for_hitl = True
943 
944                                 elif (
945                                     isinstance(evt, ToolResultEndEvent)
946                                     and evt.state
947                                     == ToolResultState.INTERRUPTED
948                                 ):
949                                     # Handle the interruption event
950                                     break_execution_for_interruption = True
951 
952                             if break_execution_for_interruption:
953                                 end_event = ReplyEndEvent(
954                                     session_id=self.state.session_id,
955                                     reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
956                                     finished_reason=(
957                                         ReplyFinishedReason.INTERRUPTED
958                                     ),
959                                 )
960                                 return
961 
962                             if break_execution_for_hitl:
963                                 break
964 
965                         if break_execution_for_hitl:
966                             # Stop executing the next batches, and go back to
967                             # ``_next_action``, which parks the reply on the
968                             # awaiting tool calls. The unfinished round isn't
969                             # counted into ``cur_iter``
970                             continue
971 
972                 # Update iteration count after each round of reasoning-acting
973                 self.state.cur_iter += 1
974 
975         except asyncio.CancelledError:
976             # Handle the CancelledError within the _reply_impl for the
977             # agent middlewares
978             end_event = ReplyEndEvent(
979                 session_id=self.state.session_id,
980                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
981                 finished_reason=ReplyFinishedReason.INTERRUPTED,
982             )
983 
984             if self.react_config.interruption_raise_cancelled_error:
985                 raise
986 
987         finally:
988             if end_event is not None:
989                 interrupted_end = (
990                     end_event.finished_reason
991                     == ReplyFinishedReason.INTERRUPTED
992                 )
993                 if interrupted_end:
994                     # Handle the context when interruption
995                     async for _ in self._close_unfinished_tool_calls():
996                         yield _
997 
998                 yield end_event
999 
1000                 if interrupted_end:
1001                     # The fallback msg goes last: Msg terminates the stream
1002                     yield AssistantMsg(
1003                         id=self.state.reply_id,
1004                         name=self.name,
1005                         content=self.react_config.interruption_message,
1006                         finished_reason=ReplyFinishedReason.INTERRUPTED,
1007                     )

1009     async def _inject_runtime_state(
1010         self,
1011     ) -> AsyncGenerator[HintBlockEvent, None]:
1012         """Inject the current runtime state (time, plan tasks and context
1013         usage) into the conversation context as a ``HintBlock``, so the agent
1014         stays aware of the information that changes across turns/replies.
1015 
1016         .. note:: The injection is **not** ephemeral. It is appended to the
1017             persistent context on purpose, so the agent can perceive how time
1018             elapses and what it did at each step, building a sense of time.
1019 
1020         .. note:: We attach a ``HintBlock`` instead of mutating the system
1021             prompt, so that prompt caching still works while the agent remains
1022             aware of the changing time / tasks / context.
1023 
1024         .. note:: Only information that *changes* within a conversation is
1025             injected here. Fixed information should live in the system prompt.
1026 
1027         The injection timing is decided per dimension:
1028 
1029         - **Time**: injected when (1) no time is recorded in the context (i.e.
1030           the first reply or right after a context compression), or (2) the
1031           elapsed time since the recorded one exceeds
1032           ``injection_config.time_interval`` hours. The injected time is the
1033           wall-clock time of ``injection_config.timezone``, and the timezone
1034           is injected next to it so that the elapsed time is still correct
1035           when the configured timezone changes within a conversation.
1036         - **Plan tasks**: injected when there are pending or in-progress tasks
1037           while the context contains neither task-related tool calls (e.g.
1038           they have been compressed away) nor a previous tasks injection.
1039         - **Context**: injected at the first iteration of a reply when the
1040           current input tokens are within
1041           ``injection_config.context_buffer_ratio`` of the compression
1042           threshold, letting the agent perceive that a compression is near.
1043           This dimension is evaluated independently of the two above.
1044 
1045         The user defined ``injection_config.extra_fields`` are attached to
1046         every injection, but never trigger one by themselves.
1047 
1048         Yields:
1049             `HintBlockEvent`:
1050                 Emitted when a runtime-state hint is injected and
1051                 ``injection_config.emit_hint_event`` is enabled.
1052         """
1053         if not self.injection_config.inject_runtime_state:
1054             return
1055 
1056         injections: dict = {}
1057 
1058         # The wall-clock time in the configured timezone. It's kept timezone
1059         # aware for the elapsed time calculation, while ``time_format`` decides
1060         # whether the timezone is carried in the injected text.
1061         now = datetime.now(_resolve_timezone(self.injection_config.timezone))
1062 
1063         # A fixed source used to detect existing injection
1064         injection_source = self.injection_config.injection_source
1065 
1066         # =====================================================================
1067         # Step 1: Analyze the current context
1068         #  - The latest injection that records a time (if any)
1069         #  - If the agent is already aware of the uncompleted tasks
1070         # =====================================================================
1071         task_status: dict = collections.defaultdict(int)
1072         for task in self.state.tasks_context.tasks:
1073             task_status[task.state] += 1
1074 
1075         has_uncompleted_tasks = (
1076             task_status["pending"] > 0 or task_status["in_progress"] > 0
1077         )
1078 
1079         # The text of the newest injection that records a time. An injection
1080         # only carries the fields triggered at that moment, so the newest one
1081         # doesn't necessarily record a time.
1082         last_time_text: str | None = None
1083 
1084         # The agent is aware of the tasks when the context contains the task
1085         # related tool calls or a previous tasks injection. Without uncompleted
1086         # tasks the flag is never used, so skip the detection entirely.
1087         aware_of_tasks = not has_uncompleted_tasks
1088 
1089         for msg in reversed(self.state.context):
1090             if last_time_text is not None and aware_of_tasks:
1091                 # Both dimensions are settled, no need to scan the older
1092                 # context
1093                 break
1094 
1095             if msg.role != "assistant":
1096                 continue
1097 
1098             for block in reversed(msg.content):
1099                 if (
1100                     isinstance(block, HintBlock)
1101                     and block.source == injection_source
1102                 ):
1103                     if isinstance(block.hint, str):
1104                         text = block.hint
1105                     else:
1106                         text = "".join(
1107                             _.text
1108                             for _ in block.hint
1109                             if isinstance(_, TextBlock)
1110                         )
1111 
1112                     if last_time_text is None and "<current-time>" in text:
1113                         last_time_text = text
1114                     if not aware_of_tasks and "<tasks>" in text:
1115                         aware_of_tasks = True
1116 
1117                 elif (
1118                     isinstance(block, ToolCallBlock)
1119                     and block.name in self.injection_config.task_tool_names
1120                 ):
1121                     aware_of_tasks = True
1122 
1123         # =====================================================================
1124         # Step 2: Check Time Injection
1125         # =====================================================================
1126         # No time recorded in the context, e.g. the first reply or right after
1127         # a context compression, so inject to be safe
1128         inject_time = True
1129         if last_time_text is not None:
1130             # Extract the recorded time from the injection, e.g.
1131             # <current-time>2026-07-01T12:00:00</current-time>
1132             match = re.search(
1133                 r"<current-time>(.*?)</current-time>",
1134                 last_time_text,
1135             )
1136             last_time = None
1137             if match is not None:
1138                 try:
1139                     last_time = datetime.strptime(
1140                         match.group(1).strip(),
1141                         self.injection_config.time_format,
1142                     )
1143                 except ValueError:
1144                     # Fail to parse the recorded time, e.g. the time format has
1145                     # changed, so inject again to be safe
1146                     last_time = None
1147 
1148             if last_time is not None:
1149                 if last_time.tzinfo is None:
1150                     # The recorded time is the wall-clock time of the timezone
1151                     # recorded next to it, e.g.
1152                     # <timezone>Asia/Shanghai</timezone>. Restore it so that
1153                     # the comparison holds even if the configured timezone has
1154                     # changed since then.
1155                     match_tz = re.search(
1156                         r"<timezone>(.*?)</timezone>",
1157                         last_time_text,
1158                     )
1159                     last_time = last_time.replace(
1160                         tzinfo=_resolve_timezone(
1161                             match_tz.group(1).strip()
1162                             if match_tz
1163                             else self.injection_config.timezone,
1164                         ),
1165                     )
1166 
1167                 elapsed_hours = (now - last_time).total_seconds() / 3600
1168                 # A negative elapsed time means the recorded time is in the
1169                 # future, e.g. the machine clock went backwards, so inject
1170                 # again to be safe
1171                 inject_time = not (
1172                     0 <= elapsed_hours <= self.injection_config.time_interval
1173                 )
1174 
1175         if inject_time:
1176             injections["current-time"] = now.strftime(
1177                 self.injection_config.time_format,
1178             )
1179             injections["timezone"] = self.injection_config.timezone
1180 
1181         # =====================================================================
1182         # Step 3: Check Plan Tasks
1183         # =====================================================================
1184         # If exists uncompleted tasks and the agent isn't aware of them, e.g.
1185         # the task related tool calls have been compressed away, so that the
1186         # same reminder isn't repeated on every iteration
1187         if has_uncompleted_tasks and not aware_of_tasks:
1188             injections["tasks"] = (
1189                 f"You have {task_status['in_progress']} in-progress tasks "
1190                 f"and {task_status['pending']} pending tasks. "
1191                 f"Use `TaskList` to view them if you don't know."
1192             )
1193 
1194         # =====================================================================
1195         # Step 4: Context Length
1196         # =====================================================================
1197         # The context length is checked independently of the dimensions above,
1198         # and only at the beginning of a reply, where the context has just
1199         # grown by the new input
1200         if self.state.cur_iter == 0:
1201             # Count the current tokens
1202             kwargs = await self._prepare_model_input()
1203             input_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(**kwargs)
1204 
1205             trigger_tokens = int(
1206                 self.context_config.trigger_ratio * self.model.context_size,
1207             )
1208 
1209             if input_tokens > (
1210                 max(
1211                     0.0,
1212                     self.context_config.trigger_ratio
1213                     - self.injection_config.context_buffer_ratio,
1214                 )
1215                 * self.model.context_size
1216             ):
1217                 # To trigger memory compress
1218                 injections["context-length"] = (
1219                     f"Your current context contains {input_tokens} "
1220                     f"tokens. When reaching {trigger_tokens} tokens, "
1221                     f"your context will be compressed."
1222                 )
1223 
1224         if injections:
1225             # The user defined fields, which don't trigger an injection by
1226             # themselves
1227             injections.update(self.injection_config.extra_fields)
1228 
1229             hint_block = HintBlock(
1230                 source=injection_source,
1231                 # Use replace instead of format, so that the other curly
1232                 # braces in the template are kept as-is
1233                 hint=self.injection_config.template.replace(
1234                     "{runtime_state}",
1235                     "\n".join(
1236                         f"<{k}>{v}</{k}>" for k, v in injections.items()
1237                     ),
1238                 ),
1239             )
1240             self.state.append_context(
1241                 self.name,
1242                 [hint_block],
1243             )
1244             if self.injection_config.emit_hint_event:
1245                 yield HintBlockEvent(
1246                     reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1247                     block_id=hint_block.id,
1248                     source=hint_block.source,
1249                     hint=hint_block.hint,
1250                 )

1255     ) -> AsyncGenerator[
1256         ModelCallStartEvent
1257         | TextBlockStartEvent
1258         | TextBlockDeltaEvent
1259         | TextBlockEndEvent
1260         | ToolCallBlock
1261         | ToolCallDeltaEvent
1262         | ToolCallEndEvent

1269         | ModelCallEndEvent

1278

1296                         ):
1297                             yield item
1298 
1299                     async for item in mw.on_reasoning(
1300                         agent=self,
1301                         input_kwargs=input_kwargs,
1302                         next_handler=next_handler,
1303                     ):
1304                         yield item
1305 
1306             async for item in execute_chain():
1307                 yield item

1309     async def _reasoning_impl(
1310         self,
1311         tool_choice: ToolChoice | None = None,
1312     ) -> AsyncGenerator[
1313         ModelCallStartEvent
1314         | TextBlockStartEvent
1315         | TextBlockDeltaEvent
1316         | TextBlockEndEvent
1317         | ToolCallBlock
1318         | ToolCallDeltaEvent
1319         | ToolCallEndEvent
1320         | ThinkingBlockStartEvent
1321         | ThinkingBlockDeltaEvent
1322         | ThinkingBlockEndEvent
1323         | DataBlockStartEvent
1324         | DataBlockDeltaEvent
1325         | DataBlockEndEvent
1326         | ModelCallEndEvent
1327         | Msg,
1328         None,
1329     ]:
1330         """Core reasoning logic. Yields chunks with is_last flag."""
1331 
1332         yield ModelCallStartEvent(
1333             reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1334             model_name=self.model.model,
1335         )
1336 
1337         # Get the input arguments for the chat model, including messages and
1338         # tools
1339         kwargs = await self._prepare_model_input()
1340 
1341         # Call the chat model
1342         res = await self._call_model(
1343             tool_choice=tool_choice,
1344             **kwargs,
1345         )
1346 
1347         block_ids: dict = {
1348             "text": None,
1349             "thinking": None,
1350             "tools": [],
1351             "data": [],
1352         }
1353         completed_response: ChatResponse | None = None
1354 
1355         # Check if res is an async generator (streaming response)
1356         if inspect.isasyncgen(res):
1357             async for chunk in res:
1358                 # Save the last chunk with completed response
1359                 if chunk.is_last:
1360                     completed_response = chunk
1361 
1362                 else:
1363                     # Convert the chunk into events
1364                     async for evt in self._convert_chat_response_to_event(
1365                         block_ids,
1366                         chunk,
1367                     ):
1368                         yield evt
1369 
1370         elif isinstance(res, ChatResponse):
1371             completed_response = res
1372             async for evt in self._convert_chat_response_to_event(
1373                 block_ids,
1374                 res,
1375             ):
1376                 yield evt
1377 
1378         # Send the ended events for the remaining active blocks
1379         if block_ids["text"] is not None:
1380             yield TextBlockEndEvent(
1381                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1382                 block_id=block_ids["text"],
1383             )
1384         if block_ids["thinking"] is not None:
1385             yield ThinkingBlockEndEvent(
1386                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1387                 block_id=block_ids["thinking"],
1388             )
1389         for tool_call_id in block_ids["tools"]:
1390             yield ToolCallEndEvent(
1391                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1392                 tool_call_id=tool_call_id,
1393             )
1394         for data_block_id in block_ids["data"]:
1395             yield DataBlockEndEvent(
1396                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1397                 block_id=data_block_id,
1398             )
1399 
1400         # Guard against empty or interrupted streaming responses.
1401         if completed_response is None:
1402             raise RuntimeError(
1403                 "Model returned an empty streaming response: no is_last=True"
1404                 " chunk was received.  The model call may have been "
1405                 "interrupted mid-stream (network dropout, timeout, or model "
1406                 "bug).",
1407             )
1408 
1409         # Send the model call ended event with usage if available
1410         yield ModelCallEndEvent(
1411             reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1412             input_tokens=completed_response.usage.input_tokens
1413             if completed_response.usage
1414             else 0,
1415             output_tokens=completed_response.usage.output_tokens
1416             if completed_response.usage
1417             else 0,
1418             finished_reason=completed_response.finished_reason,
1419         )
1420 
1421         self._save_to_context(
1422             list(completed_response.content),
1423             completed_response.usage,
1424         )
1425 
1426         # A thinking-only response is an intermediate reasoning step rather
1427         # than a user-visible final answer. Keep the ReAct loop running so the
1428         # model can produce text, data, or a tool call on the next iteration.
1429         has_only_thinking_blocks = bool(completed_response.content) and all(
1430             isinstance(block, ThinkingBlock)
1431             for block in completed_response.content
1432         )
1433 
1434         # If no tool call is generated, return the final message directly
1435         if (
1436             completed_response.finished_reason != FinishedReason.INTERRUPTED
1437             and not any(
1438                 isinstance(_, ToolCallBlock)
1439                 for _ in completed_response.content
1440             )
1441             and not has_only_thinking_blocks
1442         ):
1443             last_ctx = self._get_last_msg()
1444             final_usage = (
1445                 Usage(
1446                     input_tokens=last_ctx.usage.input_tokens,
1447                     output_tokens=last_ctx.usage.output_tokens,
1448                 )
1449                 if last_ctx is not None and last_ctx.usage is not None
1450                 else None
1451             )
1452             yield AssistantMsg(
1453                 id=self.state.reply_id,
1454                 name=self.name,
1455                 # Text only response message
1456                 content=list(completed_response.content),
1457                 usage=final_usage,
1458                 # The INTERRUPTED case is excluded by the branch condition
1459                 finished_reason=ReplyFinishedReason.COMPLETED,
1460             )

1480             `bool`:
1481                 If the agent is waiting for the incoming event, that means
1482                 this reply calling continues from the previous one. If not,
1483                 the reply id and iteration count should be updated for the new
1484                 reply.
1485         """
1486         awaiting_tool_calls = self.state.get_awaiting_tool_calls(self.name)
1487         awaiting_confirmations = [
1488             _.id
1489             for _ in awaiting_tool_calls
1490             if _.state == ToolCallState.ASKING
1491         ]
1492         awaiting_external_executions = [
1493             _.id
1494             for _ in awaiting_tool_calls
1495             if _.state == ToolCallState.SUBMITTED
1496         ]
1497 
1498         # No incoming event but needed
1499         if event is None and (
1500             awaiting_confirmations or awaiting_external_executions
1501         ):
1502             raise ValueError(
1503                 f"Agent is waiting for {len(awaiting_confirmations)} tool "
1504                 f"calls and external execution results for "
1505                 f"{len(awaiting_external_executions)} tool calls, "
1506                 f"but received no event.",
1507             )
1508 
1509         if isinstance(event, UserConfirmResultEvent):
1510             if not awaiting_confirmations:
1511                 raise ValueError(
1512                     f"Agent is not waiting for user confirmation, "
1513                     f"but received UserConfirmResultEvent: {event}",
1514                 )
1515 
1516             # Given event, required but not match
1517             extra_ids = set(
1518                 _.tool_call.id for _ in event.confirm_results
1519             ) - set(awaiting_confirmations)
1520             if extra_ids:
1521                 raise ValueError(
1522                     f"Received UserConfirmResultEvent with tool call ids "
1523                     f"{extra_ids} that are not waiting for confirmation.",
1524                 )
1525 
1526         if isinstance(event, ExternalExecutionResultEvent):
1527             if not awaiting_external_executions:
1528                 raise ValueError(
1529                     f"Agent is not waiting for external execution result, "
1530                     f"but received ExternalExecutionResultEvent: {event}",
1531                 )
1532 
1533             extra_ids = set(_.id for _ in event.execution_results) - set(
1534                 awaiting_external_executions,
1535             )
1536             if extra_ids:
1537                 raise ValueError(
1538                     f"Received ExternalExecutionResultEvent with tool call "
1539                     f"ids {extra_ids} that are not waiting for external "
1540                     f"execution results.",
1541                 )
1542 
1543         return event is not None

1545     async def _handle_incoming_event(
1546         self,
1547         event: UserConfirmResultEvent | ExternalExecutionResultEvent | None,
1548     ) -> AsyncGenerator[
1549         ToolResultStartEvent
1550         | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent
1551         | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent
1552         | ToolResultEndEvent,
1553         None,
1554     ]:
1555         """Handle the incoming event and update the context accordingly.
1556 
1557         Args:
1558             event (`UserConfirmResultEvent | ExternalExecutionResultEvent \
1559             | None`):
1560                 The incoming event to be handled.
1561 
1562         Yields:
1563             `ToolResultStartEvent \
1564             | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent \
1565             | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent \
1566             | ToolResultEndEvent`:
1567                 The events generated during the handling of the incoming event.
1568         """
1569         # Return directly if no event
1570         if event is None or len(self.state.context) == 0:
1571             return
1572 
1573         if isinstance(event, UserConfirmResultEvent):
1574             # The confirmed tool calls
1575             confirmed_tool_calls = {
1576                 _.tool_call.id: _ for _ in event.confirm_results
1577             }
1578 
1579             # Update the state with the confirmed tool calls
1580             last_msg = self.state.context[-1]
1581             for tool_call in last_msg.get_content_blocks("tool_call"):
1582                 if len(confirmed_tool_calls) == 0:
1583                     break
1584 
1585                 if tool_call.id in confirmed_tool_calls:
1586                     confirmation = confirmed_tool_calls[tool_call.id]
1587                     if confirmation.confirmed:
1588                         # Update state and wait for execution in the next step
1589                         self._update_tool_call_state(
1590                             tool_call.id,
1591                             ToolCallState.ALLOWED,
1592                         )
1593 
1594                         # Update name and  input in case user modification is
1595                         # allowed
1596                         tool_call.name = confirmation.tool_call.name
1597                         tool_call.input = confirmation.tool_call.input
1598 
1599                         # Update the permission rule if accepted
1600                         if confirmation.rules:
1601                             for rule in confirmation.rules:
1602                                 self._engine.add_rule(rule)
1603 
1604                     else:
1605                         # Update the state to deny and handling
1606                         async for evt in self._handle_error_tool_call(
1607                             tool_call,
1608                             message=(
1609                                 "<system-reminder>The execution of tool "
1610                                 f'"{tool_call.name}" is denied by user!'
1611                                 "</system-reminder>"
1612                             ),
1613                             state=ToolResultState.DENIED,
1614                         ):
1615                             yield evt
1616 
1617                     # Delete for quick lookup and later processing
1618                     confirmed_tool_calls.pop(tool_call.id)
1619 
1620         elif isinstance(event, ExternalExecutionResultEvent):
1621             # Directly append the execution results into context
1622             for tool_result in event.execution_results:
1623                 async for evt in self._convert_tool_chunk_to_event(
1624                     tool_result.id,
1625                     tool_result.output,
1626                 ):
1627                     yield evt
1628 
1629                 yield ToolResultEndEvent(
1630                     reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1631                     tool_call_id=tool_result.id,
1632                     state=tool_result.state,
1633                     metadata=tool_result.metadata,
1634                 )
1635 
1636                 self._save_to_context([tool_result])
1637 
1638                 # Update the state according to the execution result state
1639                 self._update_tool_call_state(
1640                     tool_result.id,
1641                     ToolCallState.FINISHED,
1642                 )
1643 
1644         else:
1645             raise ValueError(f"Invalid event type: {event}")

1765     async def _execute_concurrent_tool_calls(
1766         self,
1767         tool_calls: list[ToolCallBlock],
1768     ) -> AsyncGenerator[
1769         RequireUserConfirmEvent
1770         | RequireExternalExecutionEvent
1771         | ToolResultStartEvent
1772         | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent
1773         | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent
1774         | ToolResultEndEvent,
1775         None,
1776     ]:
1777         """Execute the given tool calls concurrently and yield the events.
1778 
1779         All tool calls are executed concurrently. If one or more tool calls
1780         fail, the remaining ones are **not** cancelled and will run to
1781         completion. After all tool calls finish, every exception is collected
1782         and re-raised together as an :py:exc:`ExceptionGroup` so the caller
1783         can inspect each failure individually.
1784 
1785         The event stream is guaranteed to be complete: the loop exits only
1786         after a sentinel value placed by the gather task is received, which
1787         means every ``queue.put`` from every worker has already finished
1788         before the generator returns.
1789 
1790         If the caller task is cancelled from outside, the concurrent worker
1791         tasks are cancelled explicitly (to avoid orphan tasks), any events
1792         already queued by the workers (including interruption chunks emitted
1793         by ``toolkit.call_tool`` when it catches ``CancelledError``) are
1794         flushed to the caller, and the generator returns normally. The
1795         caller is expected to detect the interruption via the flushed
1796         ``ToolResultEndEvent(state=INTERRUPTED)`` events, mirroring the
1797         event-based propagation used by
1798         :meth:`_execute_sequential_tool_calls`.
1799 
1800         Args:
1801             tool_calls (`list[ToolCallBlock]`):
1802                 The tool calls to be executed concurrently.
1803 
1804         Yields:
1805             `RequireUserConfirmEvent \
1806             | RequireExternalExecutionEvent \
1807             | ToolResultStartEvent \
1808             | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent \
1809             | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent \
1810             | ToolResultEndEvent`:
1811                 The events generated during the execution of the tool calls.
1812 
1813         Raises:
1814             `ExceptionGroup`:
1815                 Raised after all tool calls finish when one or more of them
1816                 raised an exception. Each individual exception is included in
1817                 the group.
1818         """
1819         # A sentinel object that signals all worker tasks have finished and
1820         # all events have already been put into the queue.
1821         sentinel = object()
1822 
1823         # Create a queue to collect events from all concurrent workers.
1824         queue: Queue = Queue()
1825 
1826         # Batch-shared accumulator for confirmation de-duplication: the
1827         # suggested rules of every confirmation surfaced by this batch are
1828         # collected here so a later call already covered by an earlier
1829         # call's rule is not prompted a second time. Mutated only from
1830         # synchronous sections of the workers, so no lock is needed on the
1831         # single-threaded event loop.
1832         kept_rules: list[PermissionRule] = []
1833 
1834         async def _run_all() -> list[BaseException | None]:
1835             """Run all tool calls concurrently and push the sentinel when done.
1836 
1837             Returns:
1838                 `list[BaseException | None]`:
1839                     One entry per tool call. Each entry is either ``None``
1840                     (success) or the exception raised by that tool call.
1841             """
1842             # return_exceptions=True keeps all tasks running even when some
1843             # fail, and returns exceptions as values instead of re-raising.
1844             results = await asyncio.gather(
1845                 *[
1846                     self._into_queue(tc, queue, kept_rules)
1847                     for tc in tool_calls
1848                 ],
1849                 return_exceptions=True,
1850             )
1851             # The sentinel is placed AFTER gather returns, which guarantees
1852             # that every queue.put inside _into_queue has already completed.
1853             await queue.put(sentinel)
1854             return results  # type: ignore[return-value]
1855 
1856         gather_task = asyncio.create_task(_run_all())
1857 
1858         try:
1859             # Drain the queue until the sentinel is encountered.
1860             while True:
1861                 event = await queue.get()
1862                 if event is sentinel:
1863                     break
1864                 yield event
1865         except asyncio.CancelledError:
1866             # Cancel the gather tasks, which will be handled within the toolkit
1867             gather_task.cancel()
1868             try:
1869                 await gather_task
1870             except asyncio.CancelledError:
1871                 pass
1872             while True:
1873                 try:
1874                     event = queue.get_nowait()
1875                 except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
1876                     break
1877                 if event is sentinel:
1878                     continue
1879                 yield event
1880             # Consume the cancel so this generator returns normally. The
1881             # caller relies on the flushed ``ToolResultEndEvent(state=
1882             # INTERRUPTED)`` events, not on the exception, to detect the
1883             # interruption — mirroring the event-based propagation used by
1884             # :meth:`_execute_sequential_tool_calls`.
1885             asyncio.current_task().uncancel()
1886             return
1887 
1888         # All tasks are done at this point; collect and re-raise exceptions.
1889         results = await gather_task
1890         exceptions = [r for r in results if isinstance(r, Exception)]
1891         if exceptions:
1892             raise ExceptionGroup(
1893                 "One or more tool calls raised an exception",
1894                 exceptions,
1895             )
1896 
1897     async def _into_queue(
1898         self,
1899         tool_call: ToolCallBlock,
1900         queue: Queue,
1901         kept_rules: list[PermissionRule] | None = None,
1902     ) -> None:
1903         """Execute a single tool call and forward every event into *queue*.
1904 
1905         Args:
1906             tool_call (`ToolCallBlock`):
1907                 The tool call to execute.
1908             queue (`Queue`):
1909                 The shared async queue that collects events from all
1910                 concurrent workers.
1911             kept_rules (`list[PermissionRule] | None`, defaults to `None`):
1912                 The batch-shared accumulator of already-surfaced suggested
1913                 rules, forwarded to :meth:`_execute_tool_call` for
1914                 confirmation de-duplication within the concurrent batch.
1915         """
1916         async for evt in self._execute_tool_call(tool_call, kept_rules):
1917             await queue.put(evt)

1919     async def _execute_tool_call(
1920         self,
1921         tool_call: ToolCallBlock,
1922         kept_rules: list[PermissionRule] | None = None,
1923     ) -> AsyncGenerator[
1924         RequireUserConfirmEvent
1925         | RequireExternalExecutionEvent
1926         | ToolResultStartEvent
1927         | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent
1928         | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent
1929         | ToolResultEndEvent,
1930         None,
1931     ]:
1932         """Execute a single tool call with permission checking and context
1933         management.
1934 
1935         This method handles the full tool call lifecycle: input validation,
1936         permission checking, event emission, and context writes.  The raw
1937         tool execution (``toolkit.call_tool``) is delegated to
1938         :meth:`_acting`, which is the hook point for ``on_acting``
1939         middleware.
1940 
1941         Args:
1942             tool_call (`ToolCallBlock`):
1943                 The tool call block to be executed.
1944             kept_rules (`list[PermissionRule] | None`, defaults to `None`):
1945                 A batch-scoped, shared accumulator of the suggested rules
1946                 already surfaced by earlier confirmations in the same
1947                 concurrent batch. Passed only by
1948                 :meth:`_execute_concurrent_tool_calls`; when provided, a
1949                 non-safety ASK whose invocation is already covered by an
1950                 accumulated rule is de-duplicated (left ``PENDING`` and
1951                 not surfaced again). ``None`` disables de-duplication
1952                 (e.g. sequential execution, which already parks at the
1953                 first ASK).
1954 
1955         Yields:
1956             `RequireUserConfirmEvent \
1957             | RequireExternalExecutionEvent \
1958             | ToolResultStartEvent \
1959             | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent \
1960             | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent \
1961             | ToolResultEndEvent`:
1962                 The events generated during the tool call execution.
1963         """
1964         # ===================================================================
1965         # Step 1: Check and parse the tool call input:
1966         #  - if failed, directly return the error message to the agent
1967         #  - if success, continue to permission checking and tool execution
1968         # ===================================================================
1969         try:
1970             # Check if the tool is available
1971             tool = await self.toolkit.check_tool_available(
1972                 tool_call.name,
1973                 self.state.tool_context.activated_groups,
1974             )
1975 
1976             # Try to parse the input with the tool schema
1977             parsed_input = _json_loads_with_repair(
1978                 tool_call.input,
1979                 tool.input_schema,
1980             )
1981 
1982             # Validate the parsed input with the tool schema
1983             # TODO: Maybe some logic to mix the validation error in runtime
1984             try:
1985                 jsonschema.validate(parsed_input, tool.input_schema)
1986             except jsonschema.ValidationError as e:
1987                 raise AgentOrientedException(
1988                     f"Input validation failed for tool '{tool_call.name}': "
1989                     f"{e.message}",
1990                 ) from e
1991 
1992         # The exceptions that
1993         #  - cannot found tool
1994         #  - tool not available
1995         #  - input parsing failure
1996         except AgentOrientedException as e:
1997             async for evt in self._handle_error_tool_call(
1998                 tool_call,
1999                 e.message,
2000                 state=ToolResultState.ERROR,
2001             ):
2002                 yield evt
2003 
2004             return
2005 
2006         # ===================================================================
2007         # Step 2: Check permission by toolkit and permission engine
2008         # ===================================================================
2009         if tool_call.state == ToolCallState.ALLOWED:
2010             # Already allowed by user confirmation, skip permission checking
2011             decision = PermissionDecision(
2012                 behavior=PermissionBehavior.ALLOW,
2013                 message="Already allowed by user confirmation.",
2014             )
2015         else:
2016             decision = await self._engine.check_permission(
2017                 tool,
2018                 parsed_input,
2019             )
2020 
2021         # ===================================================================
2022         # Step 3: Handle the permission and execute the tool call if allowed
2023         # ===================================================================
2024 
2025         # Case 1: Ask for user confirmation if needed
2026         if decision.behavior in [
2027             PermissionBehavior.ASK,
2028             PermissionBehavior.PASSTHROUGH,
2029         ]:
2030             # Batch de-duplication (concurrent batches only): if an earlier
2031             # confirmation in this same batch already suggested an allow rule
2032             # that matches this invocation, do not surface a second prompt.
2033             # Leave the call PENDING so the next reply run re-evaluates it
2034             # against the engine once the user answers the first prompt (and
2035             # its rule has been added). Safety ASKs (bypass-immune) are never
2036             # de-duplicated — an allow rule cannot clear them, so each must
2037             # surface its own prompt.
2038             is_safety_ask = (
2039                 decision.behavior == PermissionBehavior.ASK
2040                 and decision.bypass_immune
2041             )
2042             if kept_rules is not None and not is_safety_ask:
2043                 for rule in kept_rules:
2044                     if rule.tool_name != tool.name:
2045                         continue
2046                     if await _execute_async_or_sync_func(
2047                         tool.match_rule,
2048                         rule.rule_content,
2049                         parsed_input,
2050                     ):
2051                         # Covered by an earlier call's rule; stay PENDING and
2052                         # do not yield — re-evaluated on the next reply run.
2053                         return
2054 
2055             if kept_rules is not None:
2056                 # Register this prompt's suggested rules so later calls in the
2057                 # batch can be de-duplicated against them.
2058                 kept_rules.extend(decision.suggested_rules or [])
2059 
2060             # Set the state of the tool call to "ask"
2061             # **Note** the update must be done before yielding the event
2062             self._update_tool_call_state(
2063                 tool_call.id,
2064                 ToolCallState.ASKING,
2065             )
2066 
2067             tool_call.suggested_rules = decision.suggested_rules or []
2068             yield RequireUserConfirmEvent(
2069                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
2070                 tool_calls=[tool_call],
2071             )
2072             return
2073 
2074         # Case 2: Denied by the permission system
2075         if decision.behavior == PermissionBehavior.DENY:
2076             async for evt in self._handle_error_tool_call(
2077                 tool_call,
2078                 decision.message,
2079                 state=ToolResultState.DENIED,
2080             ):
2081                 yield evt
2082 
2083             return
2084 
2085         # Case 3: Allowed by the permission system, execute the tool call and
2086         #  yield the events
2087         if decision.behavior == PermissionBehavior.ALLOW:
2088             self._update_tool_call_state(
2089                 tool_call.id,
2090                 ToolCallState.ALLOWED,
2091             )
2092             # Send start event
2093             yield ToolResultStartEvent(
2094                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
2095                 tool_call_id=tool_call.id,
2096                 tool_call_name=tool_call.name,
2097             )
2098             # Send requiring external execution event if it's an external tool
2099             if tool.is_external_tool:
2100                 # Update the state to "submitted" BEFORE yielding
2101                 # because the outer loop will break immediately after
2102                 # receiving this event, preventing any code after yield
2103                 # from executing
2104                 self._update_tool_call_state(
2105                     tool_call.id,
2106                     ToolCallState.SUBMITTED,
2107                 )
2108                 yield RequireExternalExecutionEvent(
2109                     reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
2110                     tool_calls=[tool_call],
2111                 )
2112                 return
2113 
2114             # ================================================================
2115             # Step 4: Delegate raw execution to _acting (middleware hook point)
2116             # ================================================================
2117             async for chunk in self._acting(tool_call):
2118                 # The ToolResponse is the last and completed tool result here
2119                 if isinstance(chunk, ToolResponse):
2120                     tool_result_block = ToolResultBlock(
2121                         id=tool_call.id,
2122                         name=tool_call.name,
2123                         output=[TextBlock(text=chunk.content)]
2124                         if isinstance(chunk.content, str)
2125                         else chunk.content,
2126                         state=chunk.state,
2127                         metadata=chunk.metadata,
2128                     )
2129 
2130                     # ========================================================
2131                     # Step 5: Truncate the tool result if exceed
2132                     # ========================================================
2133                     (
2134                         reserved_tool_result_block,
2135                         offload_tool_result_block,
2136                     ) = await self._split_tool_result_for_compression(
2137                         tool_result_block,
2138                     )
2139 
2140                     # If offload result is not empty, attach reminder to the
2141                     # reserved context
2142                     if offload_tool_result_block is not None:
2143                         reminder = (
2144                             "\n<<<TRUNCATED>>>\n<system-reminder>The "
2145                             "remaining content has been omitted for "
2146                             "limited context.{offload_reminder}"
2147                             "</system-reminder>"
2148                         )
2149 
2150                         offload_reminder = ""
2151                         if self.offloader:
2152                             path = await self.offloader.offload_tool_result(
2153                                 self.state.session_id,
2154                                 offload_tool_result_block,
2155                             )
2156 
2157                             offload_reminder = (
2158                                 f" You can refer to the file in '{path}' "
2159                                 f"for the truncated content if needed."
2160                             )
2161 
2162                         reminder = reminder.format(
2163                             offload_reminder=offload_reminder,
2164                         )
2165

2372     async def _split_context_for_compression(
2373         self,
2374         to_reserved_tokens: float,
2375         tools: list[dict],
2376     ) -> tuple[list[Msg], list[Msg]]:
2377         """Split context into parts to compress and parts to keep recent.
2378 
2379         Args:
2380             to_reserved_tokens (`float`):
2381                 The tokens to be reserved.
2382             tools (`list[dict]`):
2383                 The tools JSON schemas used for token counting.
2384 
2385         Returns:
2386             `tuple[list[Msg], list[Msg]]`:
2387                 The message objects to be compressed and reserved during
2388                 context compression.
2389         """
2390 
2391         # The system prompt
2392         system_msg = [
2393             SystemMsg(name="system", content=await self._get_system_prompt()),
2394         ]
2395 
2396         # Append the current summary if exists
2397         if self.state.summary:
2398             system_msg.append(
2399                 UserMsg("user", self.state.summary),
2400             )
2401 
2402         msg_index = len(self.state.context) - 1
2403         while msg_index >= 0:
2404             # Count the tokens when msgs after msg_index are reserved
2405             reserved_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(
2406                 system_msg + self.state.context[msg_index:],
2407                 tools,
2408             )
2409             # If reserved tokens exceed the limit
2410             if reserved_tokens >= to_reserved_tokens:
2411                 break
2412             msg_index -= 1
2413 
2414         if msg_index < 0:
2415             return [], deepcopy(self.state.context)
2416 
2417         # The msgs that won't exceed the reserved token limit
2418         msgs_to_compress = self.state.context[:msg_index]
2419         msgs_to_reserve = self.state.context[msg_index + 1 :]
2420         boundary_msg = self.state.context[msg_index]
2421 
2422         # Handle the boundary Msg
2423         boundary_msg_to_compress = deepcopy(boundary_msg)
2424         boundary_msg_to_reserve = deepcopy(boundary_msg)
2425 
2426         attempt_msg = deepcopy(boundary_msg)
2427 
2428         boundary_msg_content = boundary_msg.get_content_blocks()
2429         block_index = len(boundary_msg_content) - 1
2430         while block_index >= 0:
2431             attempt_msg.content = boundary_msg_content[block_index:]
2432 
2433             try_reserved = system_msg + [attempt_msg] + msgs_to_reserve
2434             reserved_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(
2435                 try_reserved,
2436                 tools,
2437             )
2438             if reserved_tokens > to_reserved_tokens:
2439                 break
2440             block_index -= 1
2441 
2442         # Adjust the block_index to avoid splitting tool call and result pairs.
2443         # Moving the boundary can bring another tool call into the compressed
2444         # part while leaving its result reserved, so repeat until it is stable.
2445         while True:
2446             # Check if the reserved part has tool results that don't have the
2447             # corresponding tool calls
2448             remain_result_ids = {}
2449             for i in range(
2450                 len(boundary_msg_content) - 1,
2451                 block_index,
2452                 -1,
2453             ):
2454                 block = boundary_msg_content[i]
2455                 if isinstance(block, ToolResultBlock):
2456                     remain_result_ids[block.id] = i
2457                 elif isinstance(block, ToolCallBlock):
2458                     remain_result_ids.pop(block.id, None)
2459 
2460             # All tool result blocks in the reserved part are paired.
2461             if not remain_result_ids:
2462                 break
2463 
2464             # Move unmatched results into the compressed part and recheck,
2465             # because this move can split another tool call/result pair.
2466             block_index = max(remain_result_ids.values())
2467 
2468         # Split the boundary msg content
2469         boundary_msg_to_compress.content = boundary_msg_content[
2470             : block_index + 1
2471         ]
2472         boundary_msg_to_reserve.content = boundary_msg_content[
2473             block_index + 1 :
2474         ]
2475 
2476         if len(boundary_msg_to_compress.content) > 0:
2477             msgs_to_compress += [boundary_msg_to_compress]
2478 
2479         if len(boundary_msg_to_reserve.content) > 0:
2480             msgs_to_reserve = [boundary_msg_to_reserve] + msgs_to_reserve
2481 
2482         return msgs_to_compress, msgs_to_reserve
