2510     async def _split_tool_result_for_compression(
2511         self,
2512         tool_result: ToolResultBlock,
2513     ) -> tuple[ToolResultBlock, ToolResultBlock | None]:
2514         """Split the tool result for compression.
2515 
2516         Args:
2517             tool_result (`ToolResultBlock`):
2518                 The tool result block.
2519 
2520         Returns:
2521             `tuple[ToolResultBlock, ToolResultBlock | None]`:
2522                 A tuple of the tool result blocks to reserved in context and
2523                 to offload (if any).
2524         """
2525         n_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(
2526             [AssistantMsg(self.name, content=tool_result.output)],
2527             None,
2528         )
2529 
2530         # Return the tool result without truncation
2531         if n_tokens <= self.context_config.tool_result_limit:
2532             return tool_result, None
2533 
2534         # Use a copied block for token counting
2535         copied_tool_result = deepcopy(tool_result)
2536 
2537         # Normalized into content blocks
2538         if isinstance(copied_tool_result.output, str):
2539             copied_tool_result.output = [
2540                 TextBlock(text=copied_tool_result.output),
2541             ]
2542 
2543         # Find the index of the block that will exceed the limit
2544         boundary_index = 0
2545         for i in range(len(copied_tool_result.output) - 1, 0, -1):
2546             copied_tool_result.output = tool_result.output[:i]
2547             cur_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(
2548                 [
2549                     AssistantMsg(
2550                         self.name,
2551                         content=copied_tool_result.output,
2552                     ),
2553                 ],
2554                 None,
2555             )
2556             if cur_tokens < self.context_config.tool_result_limit:
2557                 boundary_index = i
2558                 break
2559 
2560         # The blocks to reserve and offload (deep copy to avoid
2561         # modifying original)
2562         reserved_blocks: list = [
2563             deepcopy(b) for b in tool_result.output[:boundary_index]
2564         ]
2565         offload_blocks: list = [
2566             deepcopy(b) for b in tool_result.output[boundary_index + 1 :]
2567         ]
2568 
2569         # Get the boundary block, if text block, we can truncate it
2570         boundary_block = tool_result.output[boundary_index]
2571         if isinstance(boundary_block, TextBlock):
2572             # Truncate it
2573             truncated_text = boundary_block.text
2574             cur_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(
2575                 [AssistantMsg(self.name, content=reserved_blocks)],
2576                 None,
2577             )
2578             cur_tokens_plus = await self.model.count_tokens(
2579                 [
2580                     AssistantMsg(
2581                         self.name,
2582                         content=reserved_blocks + [boundary_block],
2583                     ),
2584                 ],
2585                 None,
2586             )
2587             # Truncate the text by proportion of tokens
2588             token_delta = cur_tokens_plus - cur_tokens
2589             remaining_token_budget = (
2590                 self.context_config.tool_result_limit - cur_tokens
2591             )
2592             if token_delta <= 0:
2593                 reserved_tokens = (
2594                     len(truncated_text) if remaining_token_budget > 0 else 0
2595                 )
2596             else:
2597                 reserved_tokens = int(
2598                     remaining_token_budget / token_delta * len(truncated_text),
2599                 )
2600             reserved_tokens = max(
2601                 0,
2602                 min(len(truncated_text), reserved_tokens),
2603             )
2604 
2605             reserved_text = truncated_text[:reserved_tokens]
2606             offload_text = truncated_text[reserved_tokens:]
2607 
2608             if reserved_text:
2609                 if (
2610                     len(reserved_blocks) > 0
2611                     and reserved_blocks[-1].type == "text"
2612                 ):
2613                     reserved_blocks[-1].text += reserved_text
2614 
2615                 else:
2616                     reserved_blocks.append(
2617                         TextBlock(text=reserved_text, id=boundary_block.id),
2618                     )
2619 
2620             if offload_text:
2621                 if (
2622                     len(offload_blocks) > 0
2623                     and offload_blocks[0].type == "text"
2624                 ):
2625                     offload_blocks[0].text = (
2626                         offload_text + offload_blocks[0].text
2627                     )
2628 
2629                 else:
2630                     offload_blocks.insert(
2631                         0,
2632                         TextBlock(text=offload_text, id=boundary_block.id),
2633                     )
2634 
2635         else:
2636             # Drop the boundary block if inseparable
2637             offload_blocks.insert(0, boundary_block)
2638 
2639         if len(offload_blocks) == 0:
2640             return tool_result, None
2641 
2642         # Create new ToolResultBlock instances for reserved and offload
2643         reserved_tool_result = ToolResultBlock(
2644             id=tool_result.id,
2645             name=tool_result.name,
2646             output=reserved_blocks,
2647             state=tool_result.state,
2648         )
2649         offload_tool_result = ToolResultBlock(
2650             id=tool_result.id,
2651             name=tool_result.name,
2652             output=offload_blocks,
2653             state=tool_result.state,
2654         )
2655 
2656         return reserved_tool_result, offload_tool_result

2840     def _update_tool_call_state(
